newsitem.title: USA: Del Global fiscal Q4, year sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Del Global fiscal Q4, year sales rise.

text.p: Del Global Technologies Corp said Wednesday its fiscal fourth quarter sales were about $15.4 million, up from $14.4 million a year earlier. For the full year, sales rose to about $54.7 million from $43.7 million in the previous year.
The company said it believes its neo-natal imaging system will receive Food and Drug Administration approval and will be available for sale later this year.
It said its backlog increased to about $26 million from $22 million at the start of the fourth quarter.
The company said fourth quarter sales were helped by the outsourcing trend among global medical equipment makers and the expansion of international business.
It said full financial results for the fourth quarter and year, ended August 2, will be available in October.
